field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The mandated Qwen3.8 GGUF identifies the real generator.
field_principles.completion_rows: Every unit retains text, token budget, errors, and parse status.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure elapsed work with a monotonic clock; never pad or invent runtime.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host or device identity limits where the evidence applies.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo each field reason so the artifact explains its evidence contract.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names the exact failed check, upstream, field, expected value, and observed value.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Task-linked device and process measurements authenticate CUDA execution.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal description distinguishes useful evidence, null findings, disqualification, and external blocks.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe the computation actually executed, not merely planned.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use model_full_generation when the declared work runs; use blocked_no_run only before any qualifying work.
field_principles.model_specs: Resolved path, revision, quantization, and hash identify the loaded bytes.
field_principles.phase_spans: Monotonic spans separate loading, inference, tests, and cleanup.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name each resource and record its actual availability before measurement.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze randomness so another process can reconstruct the study.
field_principles.raw_manifest: Raw requests and completions permit independent replay.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash input contracts, code, seeds, and raw rows to expose drift.
field_principles.rows: Emit one row per unit and arm or condition, including errors and abstentions.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260910; never copy a historical run date.
field_principles.runner_receipt: Record model_count=1 and the selected runner; two devices are not two models.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind inputs, code, and frozen contracts to the result.
field_principles.status: Use a terminal state only after the task work is complete or externally blocked.
field_principles.trace_capture_complete_score: One means complete scheduled capture and authentic runtime evidence, regardless of correctness.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished own work is partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Declare whether the scored verifier uses the same authority that labels the outcome.

scope_answer: No terminal model measurement is available yet.
study_question: Can Qwen3.8 produce one blind structured symbolic trace for every frozen Exp7180 row?
